extension.description: Reviews gcloud Cloud DNS managed-zone, record-set, policy, and response-policy deletions and updates.
extension.name: Google Cloud DNS command protection

permissions.description: Identifies google cloud dns policy deletion operations.
permissions.label: Google Cloud DNS policy deletion
safer_guidance: Export records and confirm recovery or delegation controls before deletion.

permissions.description: Identifies google cloud dns record-set deletion operations.
permissions.example_command: gcloud dns record-sets delete www --zone public --type A
permissions.label: Google Cloud DNS record-set deletion
safer_guidance: Export records and confirm recovery or delegation controls before deletion.

permissions.description: Identifies google cloud dns record-set import operations.
permissions.example_command: gcloud dns record-sets import zone.zone --zone public
permissions.label: Google Cloud DNS record-set import
safer_guidance: Inspect the current record set and preview the intended change first.

permissions.description: Identifies google cloud dns record-set update operations.
permissions.example_command: gcloud dns record-sets update www --zone public --type A --rrdatas 192.0.2.1
permissions.label: Google Cloud DNS record-set update
safer_guidance: Inspect the current record set and preview the intended change first.
